description: Header file defining the DataElementFile class, which manages file data elements including file operations, memory mapping, and metadata access within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: DataElementFile
classes.description: Represents a file data element with capabilities for file management, including opening, closing, unlinking, destroying, and memory mapping within the WPEFramework.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the file.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the file is currently open and valid.

methods.name: Storage
methods.description: Provides access to the underlying File object.

methods.name: ErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the last error code from file operations.

methods.name: User
methods.description: Retrieves user permissions or ID for a given username.

methods.name: Group
methods.description: Retrieves group permissions or ID for a given group name.

methods.name: Unlink
methods.description: Removes the file from the filesystem.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads the file data into memory.

methods.name: Reallocation
methods.description: Handles reallocation of memory for the file data.

methods.name: OpenMemoryMappedFile
methods.description: Opens a memory-mapped version of the file with a specified size.
